tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (11.3:1).

tokens.name: color-paper-white
tokens.usage: Base mimics unbleached paper stock │. Used as text on `.btn-primary`, `.btn-tertiary:hover`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-paper-cream
tokens.usage: Secondary creates aged paper depth │. Used as text on `footer`, `.footer-section h4`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-paper-kraft
tokens.usage: Accent recalls manila folders │. Used as text on `.btn-tertiary`, `.badge-warning`, `.footer-section a:hover`. 4.2:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-charcoal
tokens.usage: Text evokes letterpress ink │. Used as text on `body`, `.logo`, `nav a`. 11.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-soft-gray
tokens.usage: Creates subtle embossing effects │. Used as text on `.footer-section a`, `.footer-bottom`. 1.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-warm-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.section-subtitle`, `.card-image`. 2.8:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Minor headings — as `h4` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `li` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata — as `div.card-meta` on the reference page.
